faqs.question: 1. Kya iske liye mujhe computer ya technical knowledge hona zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Bilkul nahi. Is tool ko khaaskar aise logon ke liye design kiya gaya hai jinhe technical cheezon ki zyada jankari nahi hoti. Aapko bas step-by-step aasan Hindi video dekh kar follow karna hai. 10 minute mai aap sab sikh jaaoge

faqs.question: 2. Kya samne wale ke phone mein koi software ya app download karni padegi?
faqs.answer: Nahi, isme kisi complicated installation ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Yeh remote network connection ke zariye safe family dashboard par jankari dikhata hai.

faqs.question: 3. Kya yeh tool Android aur iPhone dono par kaam karega?
faqs.answer: Haan, yeh tool sabhi Android, Iphone aur Laptop per poori tarah se kaam karta hai.

faqs.question: 4. Kya ₹1,999 ke baad koi aur extra monthly charges honge?
faqs.answer: Nahi, koi bhi chhupa hua monthly ya yearly charge nahi hai. Yeh ek baar ka payment hai (One-Time Payment), jisse aapko lifetime access milta hai.

faqs.question: 5. Access kitni der mein milta hai aur shuru kaise karna hai?
faqs.answer: Jaise hi aap payment complete karte hain, aapko turant access link aur video tutorial mil jata hai. Aap turant usi waqt shuru kar sakte hain. 10  minute k andar aap pura kaam kar skte hai

faqs.question: 6. Agar mujhe koi pareshani aaye toh kya customer support milega?
faqs.answer: Haan, hamari dedicated support team WhatsApp par available hai. Aap kabhi bhi message karke setup mein help le sakte hain.
